tasks.why_needed: Per user voice 2026-10-03 verbatim: '训练我们要求是在不降低训练效率的前提下能够做到随时关闭但是可以断点续训的 (每50epoch保存一次断点好了, 这个得利用日志)'. 当前 trainer save checkpoint 只在训练完成时一次 (line 1015-1022), 没有每-N-epoch 保存 + 没有 resume 加载逻辑

yaml_schema.output.checkpoint_interval: 50  # every N epochs; also save at final
yaml_schema.output.resume_from: auto  # 'auto' = scan OUT_DIR/seed*/*.pt for latest; 'none' = cold start

trainer_changes: save logic: if (epoch + 1) % args.checkpoint_interval == 0 OR epoch == epochs-1: save checkpoint with {model_state, optimizer_state, scheduler_state, epoch, best_val_auc, wasserstein_history}

load logic: at start of train_one_metal_one_seed(): if resume_from == 'auto': scan ckpt_dir for dmpnn_mtw_{metal}_seed{seed}.pt, load model+optimizer+epoch, continue from epoch+1; if resume_from == 'none': cold start; if path: load specific .pt
start_sh_changes: pass via env var WFA5_CKPT_INTERVAL + WFA5_RESUME or append to ENTRY_COMMAND
EXIT trap: on Ctrl+C / SIGTERM, write latest .pid + flush master.log + check for partial .tmp files
design.backward_compat: Default checkpoint_interval=50, resume_from='auto' = sane default; 'none' = current cold-start behavior; no breaking change to existing yaml configs

verify: §5.7 50-step CPU smoke: --resume-from none + --checkpoint-interval 5 saves at epoch 5 + reads .pt cleanly
kill trainer mid-training via Ctrl+C + restart with --resume-from auto = picks up from saved epoch + loss curve continues
master.log 包含 save/load events (per user voice '这个得利用日志')

tasks.why_needed: Per user voice 2026-10-03: '预检一下训练时的GPU算力利用率, 资源够的话就把配置拉高, 可以看看网上别人对资源配置是如何影响模型训练效果的分析 (比如batch, 这种东西还有很多, 你要自己找全)'. 当前 batch_size=64 + num_workers=unknown; Wf-431-B1 已 wire 4 NEW flags (--torch-compile / --tf32 / --cudnn-benchmark / --channels-last) 但未研究最优组合
research_scope: batch size 影响: 文献推荐 32-256 per step (NVIDIA A100 paper 推荐 8-2048); 大 batch + lr scaling (linear scaling rule + sqrt scaling for Adam)
num_workers 影响: PyTorch DataLoader 推荐 4-8 per GPU; torch.utils.data.get_worker_info() 调试
AMP bf16: NVIDIA Apex + torch.cuda.amp.autocast 推荐在 Blackwell 上开启; 2× 内存节省 + 1.5-2× 速度提升
torch.compile: PyTorch 2.x 默认 reduce-overhead 模式; Blackwell 推荐 max-autotune (10-30% 速度但首次编译 1-2 分钟)
cudnn.benchmark: 固定 input shape 时推荐开启; 否则关闭 (否则每个 batch 重新搜索)
channels_last: NHWC 内存格式; ConvNet 推荐开启; Transformer 不需要 (已经是 channels-first)
gradient_accumulation_steps: 显存不够大 batch 时用累积模拟; 推荐 effective batch = 32-128
pin_memory: 主机内存够时推荐开启; DataLoader 的 pin_memory=True 让 GPU DMA 更高效
TF32 (TensorFloat-32): Ampere+ GPU 推荐开启 (允许 FP32 tensor 用 TF32 matmul, ~10× 速度 vs FP32 strict)
学习率 scaling: 随 batch size 调整 (linear: lr = base_lr × batch_size / 256)
action_plan: 调研: 在 nvtop / Mol-Metal TUI / nvidia-smi 监测下跑 50-step smoke 跑不同 config 组合
测 (3) × (2 batch) × (2 num_workers) × (2 AMP) × (2 torch.compile) = 48 个组合 → 找出 '不降低训练效率' 的最优组合
